Its operations span a full range of services, from design and consultation to procurement, construction, and integrated project management. The company's expertise covers critical environmental areas, such as mitigating water pollution through the treatment of both municipal sewage and industrial effluents, alongside solid waste management and responsible disposal.

EICHERMOT.NS.d: Eicher Motors Limited manufactures and sells motorcycles and commercial vehicles in India and internationally. The company owns the Royal Enfield motorcycle brand that offers Classic, Bullet, Himalayan, Interceptor INT 650, Continental GT 650, and Thunderbird models. It designs, develops, manufactures, assembles, and sells two-wheelers, as well as sells related parts and accessories.

GICRE.NS.d: General Insurance Corporation of India provides reinsurance services in India and internationally. It offers property, energy, marine, engineering, liability, spares, health, agriculture/weather, motor and workmen compensation, fire, aviation, life reinsurance, and miscellaneous products, as well as marine hull, cargo, and offshore energy reinsurance products. The company also provides reinsurance solutions for the Afro-Asian region and reinsurance programs in South East Asia, the Middle East, and Africa.

HAWKINCOOK.NS.d: Hawkins Cookers Limited manufactures and markets pressure cookers and cookware. The company's flagship product is the Hawkins pressure cooker. Hawkins Cookers Limited is based in Mumbai, India.

HISARMETAL.NS.d: Hisar Metal Industries Limited manufactures and sells cold rolled stainless steel strips, tubes, and pipes in India. The company also exports its products. Hisar Metal Industries Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Hisar, India.

INDIGO.NS.d: InterGlobe Aviation Limited provides air transportation services in India and internationally. The company primarily operates IndiGo passenger airline. It also offers ancillary products and services, such as cargo, service requests, ticket modification or cancellation, in-flight sales, and tours services. As of March 31, 2020, the company operated a fleet of 262 aircraft. InterGlobe Aviation Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Gurugram, India.

ISFT.NS.d: IntraSoft Technologies Limited, through its subsidiaries, develops and delivers e-commerce and e-cards through Internet platform in India and internationally.

JSWSTEEL.NS.d: JSW Steel Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of iron and steel products in India and internationally. The company provides hot rolled and cold-rolled coils, and electrical steel products, as well as galvanized, galvalume, and color coated products; and TMT bars, wire rods, and special alloy steel products. Its products are used in automotive, general engineering, machinery, and projects and construction applications.

KPIGREEN.NS.d: KPI Green Energy Limited, set up in 2008, with its head office in Surat, India, produces and distributes solar power in India, mainly under the Solarism brand. It develops, builds, owns, operates and maintains solar plants, acting as both an independent power producer and a captive power producer.

M&MFIN.NS.d: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides asset finance in the rural and semi-urban areas in India. The company offers financing for auto and utility vehicles, tractors, cars, commercial vehicles and construction equipment, and preowned and others vehicles to transport operators, farmers, small businesses and self-employed and salaried individuals; personal Loans for weddings, children's education, medical treatment, and working capital for a small or medium-sized…

MACPOWER.NS.d: Macpower CNC Machines Limited operates as a CNC manufacturing company in India. The company offers CNC turning centers for the bearing, valve, pump, tool room, automobile, process plant component, agriculture, textile, and piping industries; and vertical machining centers (VMCs) for tool rooms, die and molds, automobile, pattern, defense, power, and railways.

NEWJAISA.NS.d: Newjaisa Technologies Ltd. is a technology-driven, direct-to-consumer company specializing in the refurbishment and sale of IT electronics. The company's operations encompass an end-to-end reverse supply chain for IT assets, involving the procurement of used laptops, desktops, and peripherals, their refurbishment to near-new condition, and subsequent sale to end-users. Newjaisa provides quality refurbished computing devices at discounted prices compared to new products.

NIDAN.NS.d: Nidan Laboratories & Healthcare Ltd. is an India-based company operating in the healthcare sector, specializing in comprehensive diagnostic services. The company provides an extensive range of pathology services, including biochemistry, hematology, microbiology, cytogenetic, and molecular diagnostic tests. Additionally, it offers a broad spectrum of radiology services such as CT scans, MRI, X-rays, and ultrasounds, along with cardiology and neurology diagnostic services and various health and wellness packages.

NLCINDIA.NS.d: NLC India Limited operates an energy company in India. It operates in two segments, Lignite Mining and Power Generation. The company is involved in the generation of power through thermal, wind, and solar photo voltaic power plants. It operates five thermal power stations with an aggregate installed capacity of 3240 MW; and 34 wind turbine generators with capacity of 1.50 MW each, as well as commissioned 440 MW solar photo voltaic power plant in Neyveli. The company also mines for lignite.

NRL.NS.d: Nupur Recyclers Limited is a metal scrap processing and recycling specialist, set up in 2019 and headquartered in Delhi. It sources, processes and trades ferrous and non-ferrous metal waste in India and abroad, importing grades like shredded zinc, die-cast zinc, stainless steel and aluminium zorba. It also takes part in manufacturing and wider trading.

OBEROIRLTY.NS.d: Oberoi Realty Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in real estate development and hospitality businesses in India. The company develops residential, commercial, retail and social infrastructure projects. It also leases office and retail spaces. In addition, the company engages in the hotel operations comprising sale of rooms, food and beverages, and allied services; and provision of property management services. Oberoi Realty Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

PANAMAPET.NS.d: Panama Petrochem Limited manufactures and sells specialty petroleum products in India. The company offers white/liquid paraffin oil; petroleum jellies; transformer oil; ink and coating oils; rubber process oil; industrial oils and lubricants; lithium and lithium complex, calcium based, sodium based, and aluminum greases; automotive engine, and gear and transmission oils, as well as other automotive lubricants; drilling fluids; and fully- and semi-refined paraffin, slack, and micro waxes.

POWERGRID.NS.d: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited, a central transmission utility, engages in the transmission of power in India. The company is involved in planning, executing, owing, operating, and maintaining high voltage transmission systems. As of March 31, 2010, it owned and operated 1,56,884 ckt kms of transmission lines, as well as 244 substations with transformation capacity of 4,00,269 MVA.

RADICO.NS.d: Radico Khaitan Limited manufactures and sells Indian made foreign liquor (IMFL) in India. The company provides IMFL products in various categories of whisky, brandy, rum, and white spirits under the brand names of Magic Moments and Magic Moments Verve Vodka, Morpheus and Morpheus Blue Brandy, 8PM and 8PM Premium Black Whisky, 1965 The Spirit of Victory Rum, Rampur Indian Single Malt Whisky, Jaisalmer Indian Craft Gin, Contessa Rum, Old Admiral Brandy, After Dark Whisky, Pluton Bay Rum, and Regal Talon Whisky.

RAILTEL.NS.d: RailTel Corporation of India Limited provides broadband telecom and multimedia networks and services in India and internationally. The company operates through Telecom Services and Project Work Services segments. It offers E-office, HD video conferencing, data center, RailWire broadband, leased line, virtual private network, internet leased line, consultancy, signaling, rack and space collocation, tower collocation, NLD voice carriage, and aadhaar based services.

SECURKLOUD.NS.d: SecureKloud Technologies Limited provides information and technology services in the United States, India, the Middle East, North America, and internationally.

SHADOWFAX.NS.d: Shadowfax Technologies Limited is an Indian logistics company built around technology, handling third-party delivery work. Its offerings range from parcel delivery and return pickups to quick-commerce and hyperlocal on-demand deliveries, mobility and dark store operations. Its enterprise customers include e-commerce, food marketplace and mobility businesses. The company was incorporated in 2015.

SHRIPISTON.NS.d: Shriram Pistons & Rings Limited manufactures and sells automotive components in India. It offers pistons, piston pins, piston rings, and engine valves. The company also exports its products. It serves OEMs operating in the passenger vehicle, two/three wheeler, commercial vehicle, tractor, and industrial engine markets. The company was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

SPECTSTM.NS.d: Spectrum Talent Management Ltd. is a global human resource services company that provides a comprehensive suite of manpower solutions. Its primary offerings include recruitment process outsourcing, global search and selection, general staffing, IT staff augmentation, and apprentice solutions. The company also offers managed services covering payroll, compliance management, and onboarding processes.

SPLIL.NS.d: SPL Industries Limited designs, manufactures, and sells cotton knitted garments and made ups in India. The company operates through two segments, Manufacturing and Trading. It offers single jersey, jacquard, interlocks, flat backs, auto stripes fleece, double jersey jacquard, and waffles and various texture fabrics; and range of outer wear, such as T shirts, sweat shirts, polo shirts, etc. The company also trades in garments; and exports its products.

TENNIND.NS.d: Tenneco Clean Air India Limited supplies emissions and powertrain components and also advanced ride technologies, which are its two business segments. Its range includes catalytic converters, mufflers, exhaust pipes, engine bearings, seals, spark plugs, ignition coils, shock absorbers and suspension systems, used in vehicles and other applications.

TOUCHWOOD.NS.d: Touchwood Entertainment Limited engages in the event management activities in India. It provides wedding management, design and décor, destination wedding, entertainment, political and corporate event, curated IPs, and exhibition services. Touchwood Entertainment Limited was founded in 1997 and is based in New Delhi, India.

VIMTALABS.NS.d: Vimta Labs Limited provides contract research and testing services in India and internationally. The company offers laboratory, food and water testing and analysis, preclinical and clinical research, biological molecule structural and functional analysis, environmental assessment, and clinical reference laboratory services. It serves the pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, food, consumer products, agrochemical, healthcare, medical device, and other industries.

VISESHINFO.NS.d: MPS Infotecnics Limited provides information technology (IT) solutions to organizations worldwide. The company operates through three segments: Telecommunication, IT Solutions & Products, and IT Enabled Services. It provides BusinesSoft, a solution for service, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, chemical, and trading companies; BusinessPro, which automates the functions of an organization and deploys enterprise wide applications; and domain name registration and Web hosting services in cloud infrastructure.

VMM.NS.d: Vishal Mega Mart Ltd., set up in 2018, with its head office in Gurugram, operates in wholesale, trading and retail. It sells apparel for all ages and genders, from t-shirts and denim to sportswear, nightwear, innerwear and ethnic clothing, along with general merchandise.

WEWIN.NS.d: We Win Limited, headquartered in Bhopal and established in 2007, provides customer relationship management services across India. These include e-commerce management, lead generation, telemarketing, sales call centres, customer care, back-office support, and call centre operations for inbound and outbound calls.

ZAGGLE.NS.d: Mumbai-based Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited, founded in 2011, develops financial products that automate business expense management for corporations, small and mid-sized businesses and startups. Its Propel SaaS platform handles channel rewards, incentives and staff recognition, while Save is a SaaS platform and mobile app for managing spend and digital reimbursements.
